title: National Theater of Scotland Festival / Folded print

location.series: Pentagram / The Public Theater case study

slide_intent: Coordinate covers and interior spreads because a publication must invite opening and remain navigable afterward.
strategic_value: Repeated borders, strong titles and vivid accents can carry the Public identity into a multipage festival program.
demonstration: Several standing and open printed pieces combine black rules, cropped images and bright green or pink headings.
practical_value: Compare the relationship between a closed cover, open spreads and a small companion piece.

content_islands.name: Print family
content_islands.spec: Group the tall covers behind an opened booklet and small front card.

content_islands.name: Interior structure
content_islands.spec: Keep black borders and colored title blocks visible across the exposed pages.

reference_purposes.Expression: Several standing and open printed pieces combine black rules, cropped images and bright green or pink headings.
reference_purposes.Application: The identity appears on covers, open booklet spreads and a small companion card.
